reason: Seven corrections from the v1.35 hand inspection of the 112-sentence residue that no reading gate inspects (docs/measurements/v126-uninspected-residue.json; every verdict in docs/measurements/v135-residue-inspection.json). Each was upheld by two independent refuters. n4-g386: 何 before を is なに; exKana and the 何 token said なん, Sudachi's default copied into the corpus (PLAN-V1.25 corrected n5-g021 for the same なんを). Kyoko's render of the sentence with only 何 replaced by なに is byte-identical to the exJP audio, and the なん substitution is not; that is the record's own v1.29 proof, '何 なん -> なに'. n2-b103: 金を奪った means money here (exEN 'stole my money', exZH 骗走了我的钱), read かね; exKana and the 金 token said きん (gold), Sudachi's default. The voice cannot arbitrate: Kyoko also reads 金 as きん where only money makes sense (n2-b427 やたらに金を遣って is byte-identical to its きん spelling), so she shares Sudachi's blind spot. The verdict rests on the meaning and both translations. 私 わたくし is the register class PLAN-V1.25 declines and is untouched. n3-k030: exJP spelled 機 in hiragana (ジェットきに乗る), a spelling no writer uses: 684493d generated it while the surface was still ジェット and copied the kana field, and v1.15 H (5bc8596) extended the surface without touching the sentence. usesTheWord passed it through e.kana. exJP is now ジェット機に乗る。 and exTokens is regenerated by gen_sentence_kana.read_sentence (Sudachi C: ジェット機[じぇっとき] に 乗る 。), removing the stray き token the lookup chip would have landed on. exKana is unchanged. Kyoko renders ジェット機に乗る。 byte-identical to ジェットきに乗る。 (sha1 1b8ed80de3c9), so the dictation audio does not move. n4-g012: 以下 includes its boundary; 'Under 10 years old is free.' excluded age 10, the one distinction a 以下 card teaches. exEN only; the sentence stays display-only (digits, pinned in sentencesWithoutReadings). n4-g032: 〜のうち here is 'among / of', not physical 'inside'; 'Choose one from inside the three.' is not English. exEN only. n1-g219: 'My face will warp with pain.' used the material sense of 'warp' for a face and imposed a future. exEN only; the reading ゆがむ is correct and the voice's ひずむ stays recorded and excluded. n2-b962: a generator annotation leaked into the glosses the learner sees: meanings.en[2] 'to be upset (typo of hikkurikaeru)' and meanings.zh[2] '倾覆 (疑为ひっくりかえる的笔误)', on the ひっくりかえる entry itself (the only 'typo'/'笔误' in the corpus; git log -S traces it to df5f5f6, the batch-4 'LLM meanings' import). Replaced in place by 'to be overturned' (the refuter's wording; 'to capsize' is boat-specific and the example is a bicycle) and '倾覆'. check_vocab_diff has no in-place gloss edit, so each is declared as the removal of the old gloss; finalEN/finalZH state the intended lists. The example is unchanged. Dictation: n4-g386 is released back into dictation. Re-measured with instrument 1b on the corrected tokens (calibrated: 0 spurious decoy matches, 0 contradictions of instrument 1's proofs), 何 = なに is confirmed and the なん render is not byte-identical, so the voice now says the corpus reading (docs/measurements/v135-dictation-remeasure.json). n2-b103 stays withheld: 1b proves 私 = わたし, and the voice also says 金 = きん against the corrected かね. n3-k030 stays in the pool with unchanged audio. Declined: n1-g046 (奢る for 驕る; split vote, same lexeme and sense, already on knownVariantSpelling) and n4-k016 (けしゴム for 消しゴム; refuted by both). Recorded uncertain and unchanged: n5-kuru, n3-b653, n2-k006. ROUND 2 (the review of these corrections). The review of n4-g386's correction asked whether 何 read なん was a one-off and found a class: thirteen more sentences where 何 heads 何を / 何も / 何より(も) / 何か / 何かと and exKana and the 何 token carry Sudachi's default なん. Every one was upheld by two independent refuters and is corrected here, exKana and that one token only (evidence per id below). Eight already carried the voice's proof in dictation-reading-mismatches.json as '何 なん -> なに' (v1.29, instrument 1b); n2-b884's record named 私 only, and 1b now also confirms なに there. Re-measured together with instrument 1b, calibrated (13/13 rebuild identity, 0 spurious byte matches in 26 decoys, 0 contradictions of instrument 1 in 39): 8 confirm 何 = なに and are RELEASED to dictation; n2-b884 stays withheld because the voice says 私 = わたし, and 私 stays わたくし under PLAN-V1.25's register rule; n1-g343, n1-b065, n2-b1100 and n3-b234 stay withheld because 1b is still silent, so for those four the correction rests on the grammar and the refuters, not on the voice (docs/measurements/v135-dictation-remeasure.json, 'round2'). Two gloss findings from the same review: n4-g012 以下 glossed 'less than', which contradicts the corrected example (以下 includes its boundary) and duplicates 未満's gloss; replaced in place by 'not more than', declared as removeEN + finalEN like n2-b962 (meanings.zh 以下 is inclusive in normal Chinese usage and is unchanged). n4-g032 内 (うち) lacked the 'among / of (a group)' sense its example 三つのうち一つ teaches: 'among' and '当中' (the word exZH uses) are appended, which the append-only rule allows without a declaration; finalEN/finalZH state the result. check_vocab_diff now enforces every finalEN/finalZH it is given. ROUND 3 (the review of round 2). n5-g022, found by that review's sweep and upheld by two refuters: 今、何時ですか。 read 何時 as なんどき, an archaic reading that survives in いつ何時 ('at any moment'); 'What time is it now?' is なんじ, and exKana and the 何時 token are corrected to it. なんどき is Sudachi's default copied into the corpus (4ceba24 (v1.18 A) generated it with gen_sentence_kana from Sudachi's ナンドキ, and 7f71a3d (v1.18 B) carried it into the punctuation-free exKana), and because Sudachi offers no なんじ for 何時 no dictation instrument ever tested the standard reading, so the sentence sat in the dictation pool grading against なんどき. Re-measured on the corrected tokens with calibrated instrument 1b, the voice is silent on 何時, so the sentence is now withheld from dictation (docs/measurements/v135-dictation-remeasure.json, 'round3'). The sweep of every 何 token in the corpus found no other sentence reading that looks wrong; one headword question (n1-b1232 何々 taught as どれどれ, no example) is left as a follow-up (docs/measurements/v135-residue-inspection.json, 'roundThree'). n4-g018, from the same review: 以上 was glossed 'more than', the inclusive-boundary error round 2 corrected in 以下: 以上 includes its boundary (18歳以上 admits 18). Replaced in place by 'not less than', declared removeEN + finalEN like n4-g012. The example 期待以上だった / 'It was more than expected.' is idiomatic ('beyond expectations') and unchanged, and ROUND 4 adds 'beyond' to meanings.en so the card still carries the sense its own example uses, which the bare replacement had dropped, without reintroducing the numeric boundary error: meanings.en is now ['not less than', 'beyond', 'above']; and meanings.zh 以上 is inclusive in normal Chinese usage and unchanged.
